nodes.label: Customer
nodes.description: A shopper who has added items to their cart and checks out.

nodes.label: ExpressCheckout
nodes.description: One-tap checkout that skipped the cart review and stock check, charging a saved card immediately.

tactical.explanation: ExpressButton called OrderService.expressCheckout(savedCardId). Reachability: the button was removed from CartPage in commit a1b2c3d ('drop express checkout — oversold too often'); expressCheckout has no remaining caller.

usages.explanation: ExpressButton called OrderService.expressCheckout(savedCardId). Reachability: the button was removed from CartPage in commit a1b2c3d ('drop express checkout — oversold too often'); expressCheckout has no remaining caller.

nodes.label: Order
nodes.description: A customer order: header plus line items, with status and total. Emits an event when placed.

tactical.explanation: OrderService.placeOrder inserts an orders row and order_items rows in one transaction, status='Placed', then returns the order id.

usages.explanation: expressCheckout inserted the order without the stock invariant the standard placeOrder enforces — the reason it was retired.
OrderService.placeOrder inserts an orders row and order_items rows in one transaction, status='Placed', then returns the order id.

nodes.label: OrderPlaced
nodes.description: An order existed in status Placed — but possibly for out-of-stock items in this retired path.

tactical.explanation: The committed orders + order_items write; placeOrder returns the order and the UI navigates to the confirmation page.

usages.explanation: Same event as the live flow; here reached without the stock guard.
The committed orders + order_items write; placeOrder returns the order and the UI navigates to the confirmation page.

nodes.label: Cart summary
nodes.description: The line items, quantities, and running total the customer reviews before checkout.

tactical.explanation: CartPage renders the session cart from CartService.GetCart(); the checkout button is disabled while the cart is empty.

usages.explanation: CartPage renders the session cart from CartService.GetCart(); the checkout button is disabled while the cart is empty.

nodes.label: PlaceOrder
nodes.description: Customer submits the cart as an order.

tactical.explanation: Checkout button calls OrderService.placeOrder(cart, customerId), which validates stock and payment before creating the order.

usages.explanation: Checkout button calls OrderService.placeOrder(cart, customerId), which validates stock and payment before creating the order.

nodes.label: Every line must have stock available
nodes.description: An order is rejected if any line item's requested quantity exceeds on-hand stock.

tactical.explanation: placeOrder loops items and throws OutOfStockError when InventoryRepo.onHand(sku) < qty, before any write.

usages.explanation: placeOrder loops items and throws OutOfStockError when InventoryRepo.onHand(sku) < qty, before any write.

nodes.label: Payment must authorize before the order is created
nodes.description: The order is only written after the payment gateway authorizes the charge.

tactical.explanation: placeOrder awaits PaymentGateway.authorize(total); a declined result throws PaymentDeclinedError before the insert.

usages.explanation: placeOrder awaits PaymentGateway.authorize(total); a declined result throws PaymentDeclinedError before the insert.

nodes.label: Payment gateway
nodes.description: Third-party payment processor. Authorizes and captures card charges over HTTPS.

tactical.explanation: PaymentGateway wraps the processor's REST API; authorize() places a hold, capture() settles it after fulfillment.

usages.explanation: PaymentGateway wraps the processor's REST API; authorize() places a hold, capture() settles it after fulfillment.

nodes.label: Whenever an order is placed, reserve its stock
nodes.description: Placing an order immediately decrements on-hand stock for each line so the same unit can't be sold twice.

tactical.explanation: Inline after commit, placeOrder calls InventoryService.reserve(items) — a separate store (inventory) with its own failure window, hence a policy-issued command.

usages.explanation: Inline after commit, placeOrder calls InventoryService.reserve(items) — a separate store (inventory) with its own failure window, hence a policy-issued command.

nodes.label: ReserveStock
nodes.description: Decrement on-hand stock for each ordered line.

tactical.explanation: InventoryService.reserve updates inventory.on_hand per sku; failures are logged and do not roll back the order (a hotspot).

usages.explanation: InventoryService.reserve updates inventory.on_hand per sku; failures are logged and do not roll back the order (a hotspot).

nodes.label: Inventory
nodes.description: On-hand stock per SKU. Decremented when an order reserves stock.

tactical.explanation: inventory table keyed by sku; reserve() is the only write path in this flow.

usages.explanation: inventory table keyed by sku; reserve() is the only write path in this flow.

nodes.label: StockReserved
nodes.description: On-hand stock has been decremented for the order's lines.

tactical.explanation: Aftermath of the inventory update; nothing subscribes downstream in this toy model.

usages.explanation: Aftermath of the inventory update; nothing subscribes downstream in this toy model.

flows.name: Customer checks out in one tap (retired)
flows.summary: A one-tap express checkout that charged a saved card and created the order without a stock check. It oversold too often and its button was removed in commit a1b2c3d; the standard place-order flow (with a stock invariant) is the replacement. The service method still compiles but has no caller.
flows.trigger: Express-checkout button on the cart page (removed in commit a1b2c3d — currently unreachable)

flows.name: Customer places an order
flows.summary: The customer reviews their cart and checks out. The order is created only after stock is confirmed and the payment gateway authorizes the charge; on success, stock is reserved in a separate step whose failure does not roll back the order.
flows.trigger: Checkout button on the cart page

hotspots.label: Retired express-checkout code still ships
hotspots.description: expressCheckout is unreachable since commit a1b2c3d but still compiled and tested. Human question: delete it, or is express checkout planned to return with a stock guard?

tactical.explanation: No caller of OrderService.expressCheckout anywhere in the tree; git show a1b2c3d removed the button.

hotspots.label: Stock reservation is not atomic with order creation
hotspots.description: Reservation runs after the order transaction commits, in a separate store, and its failure is only logged. An order can exist for stock that was never decremented, so the same unit can be oversold. Human question: should reserve() share the order transaction, or should a failed reservation cancel/flag the order?

tactical.explanation: OrderService.placeOrder commits the order at line 61, then calls InventoryService.reserve at line 63 outside any transaction; reserve swallows failures (InventoryService.ts:31).

terms.definition: Referenced in code comments as an alternate path when stock is unavailable, but no reachable handler was found.
terms.openQuestion: Is backorder a real supported flow or dead intent? No code path reserves against future stock; a human who knows the business should confirm whether backorder is expected to work.

terms.definition: A customer's confirmed purchase: the aggregate that owns line items, totals, and the order lifecycle once checkout succeeds. It is created by PlaceOrder and is the root the rest of fulfilment hangs off.
The per-variant product identifier stock is tracked against. Reservation and availability checks key off the SKU, not the product.
A soft hold placed on inventory for a SKU while an order is being placed, released if payment fails.
